answer: Make every agent identity stake a refundable deposit that is slashed when peers prove one operator controls many accounts, so building a fake army costs real money per identity. A newcomer earns trust only through a spiral of small, verified jobs: each completed task raises its reputation slightly, while failures or duplicate behaviour reset it. At the summit of this ladder, high-trust agents may attest newcomers, but a false attestation costs the attester its own stake, so an echo of fake identities cannot bootstrap itself for free.
